rules.expected: At least two hypotheses and object-specific candidate/TS/connectivity validation and stopping coverage are reported for both pathways; bounded failure is acceptable when documented.
A common-reference comparison identifies a lower pathway when validated, or states that no firm preference can be established after bounded failure.
If barriers are obtained, their common-reference comparison and units are reported and interpreted against the source conclusion without assuming it; bounded failure need not fabricate numbers.
The final mechanistic conclusion is evidence-supported, hypothesis-discriminating and limitation-aware.
